name: ntfy
description: Simple HTTP-based pub-sub notification service. Send push notifications to your phone or desktop via scripts.
summary: ntfy v2.27.0 (released 2026-08-04, https://github.com/binwiederhier/ntfy/releases/tag/v2.27.0) is the latest release, adding email-based login, hardening the message templating engine against memory exhaustion attacks, and promoting PostgreSQL support out of experimental status. v2.26.x added CPU DoS protection for message templates, configurable date/time formats in the web app, and an abuse ban-feed for fail2ban integration. v2.25.0 introduced password reset via emailed magic links, reworked email verification to use durable single-use tokens, and fixed several self-hosting issues including S3-compatible HTTP endpoints and auth-default-access sync topics.

answers.What is the current license?: Apache 2.0 (server) / GPL 2.0 (client libraries) — check repository for exact terms
answers.Is the project actively maintained?: Yes — multiple releases in 2026, active bug fixes and feature development
answers.Does it support authentication and acces: Yes — username/password auth, access tokens, email-based login, topic reservations, and configurable default access policies
answers.Is there a hosted cloud version availabl: Yes — ntfy.sh is the official hosted instance

breaking_excerpts: Message cache databases from ntfy older than v1.10.0 (November 2021) can no longer be migrated; upgrade via an older ntfy version first, or delete the cache database.
X-Email: yes now requires being logged in with a verified primary address; previously it was rejected unless smtp-sender-verify was enabled, changing prior behavior.
Secrets are now excluded from the config hash served to the web app, which may affect tooling that relied on inspecting that endpoint.

alternatives.name: Pushover
alternatives.review: Paid SaaS, simple API, iOS/Android apps.

alternatives.name: Gotify
alternatives.review: Self-hosted only, real-time push via WebSocket.

alternatives.name: Apprise
alternatives.review: Apprise is a powerful multi-platform notification library supporting dozens of services but is a library/CLI tool rather than a standalone pub-sub server, requiring more integration work than ntfy.

alternatives.name: Pushbullet
alternatives.review: Pushbullet provides cross-device notifications and file sharing via a polished interface but is a proprietary cloud service with a restrictive free tier and no self-hosting, unlike ntfy.

alternatives.name: Ntopng Alerts / Grafana Alerting
alternatives.review: Grafana Alerting is a robust alerting system integrated with observability stacks but is heavily tied to metrics dashboards and far more complex to set up than ntfy's simple HTTP pub-sub model.
